record.summary: Strategist fork: consumption betas stale ~2x; deploy-frame engine supply at beta_v=0.40 (v-only) = -10.6/-15.3/-7.8% raw on r35/r100/r150, additive to the deployed card (which carries only the learned F2J operator). First reading 'value needs the 1024^3 tensor, 42x budget, no path' RETRACTED: the KILL_TENSOR/RECON_K/TUCKER_B collapses are wedge cascades (zeroing/truncating distinct content breaks the plane/distinct cancellation on the push; next pre-plane 4.5x off-scale). Decisive data: DTOT=2 engine +9.8 vs full +10.3 -> the value rides order-2 path words = the card's own CP3 births (carried exactly, cap 16384 non-binding). Residual engine-vs-card differences are 1024^2-class (plane emission with Edgeworth channels; exact plane push; marginal-only reads). Carrier criterion: per-layer K21 plane error <= the closure's ~7%. Util-floor play dead (CP3 cap ladder 8192 -> +351% raw); plain MC at budget 1.03e-6.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed as measured history: the retraction and the corrected reading are banked (LANE T-12..T-19, memory p2-third-order-carrier-wall rewritten).
